title: EALM: Introducing Multidimensional Ethical Alignment in Conversational Information Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models using the QA-ETHICS and MP-ETHICS datasets through binary and multi-label classification tasks to assess the acceptability of generated text across five multidimensional ethical concepts: Commonsense morality, Deontology, Justice, Utilitarianism, and Virtue.
